answer: Every new agent locks a 180 POA basalt bond for 75 days, one bond per key, so a thousand fakes cost a farm 180,000 POA. The bond only unlocks after a voyage of three paid jobs for three unrelated clients, done one after another, so time is a price a farm cannot split. Each client signs the finished job with a quill receipt only that client can issue. Six auditors drawn at random check the receipts against client records; a forged one costs the whole bond and bars the key for two years.
